limitations: PHPMailer MIME is captured, with no outbound email. Merchant SMTP receipt remains a production gate.
Hourly hooks and persisted reservations are exercised directly; the fixture disables automatic WP-Cron. Merchant scheduler timing remains unverified.
The overlapping-worker check interleaves execution after reservation; it is not a multi-worker load benchmark.
Local Chrome is verified; other browser/OS combinations require the pending CI run.
Published alpha.3 ZIPs have not changed. Paid sales and marketplace listings are not live.
